courses.overview: 從「伊泰普水電站」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.whyEn: Compare Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant with Three Gorges Dam Engineering: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

related.transferEn: Hydropower complexes integrate reservoir, intake, pressure-water routes, machines and transmission with river and environmental management.

related.differenceEn: Itaipu spans Brazil and Paraguay; Three Gorges includes major navigation facilities, with different hydrology, governance and operating objectives.

related.transfer: 大型再生能源都把自然能量轉成機械和電力，再透過電網介面交付。
related.transferEn: Large renewable-energy projects convert natural energy into mechanical and electrical energy before grid delivery.
related.difference: 伊泰普以可調度水流驅動水輪機；離岸風電受風況影響，儲能條件、機組配置和維護環境不同。
related.differenceEn: Itaipu uses controlled water flow through turbines; offshore wind varies with wind conditions, with different storage context, machine layouts and maintenance environments.
practice: 畫出水輪與風輪的能量鏈
比較可控輸入與天候輸入
列出容量之外應記錄的運行資料
practiceEn: Draw hydro and wind energy chains
List operating data needed beyond nameplate capacity

related.title: 三峽水電站發電系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「水錘與導葉關閉規律」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；三峽水電站發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Water hammer and guide-vane closure" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦兩國兩種頻率的 14,000 MW 電站、空心重力壩與直流輸電；三峽水電站發電系統則以巨型低水頭法蘭西斯機組、防洪調度與通航建築物的整合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A 14,000 MW binational station with two frequencies, a hollow gravity dam and HVDC export; Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System centres on integrating giant low-head Francis units, flood operation and navigation structures, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「比速與水輪機型式」的模型移到三峽水電站發電系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「水錘與導葉關閉規律」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Specific speed and turbine type" to Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Water hammer and guide-vane closure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「水錘與導葉關閉規律」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；三峽水電站發電系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Water hammer and guide-vane closure" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System must be respecified.

related.title: 古里水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「水錘與導葉關閉規律」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；古里水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Water hammer and guide-vane closure" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Guri Hydroelectric Power Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦兩國兩種頻率的 14,000 MW 電站、空心重力壩與直流輸電；古里水電站則以分期加高的重力壩、巨型水庫與單一電源過度集中的系統風險為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A 14,000 MW binational station with two frequencies, a hollow gravity dam and HVDC export; Guri Hydroelectric Power Plant centres on A gravity dam raised in stages, a giant reservoir and the system risk of over-concentration in one source, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「水頭、流量與出力」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「比速與水輪機型式」的模型移到古里水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「單一外送通道與全國停電」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Head, discharge and output" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "Specific speed and turbine type" to Guri Hydroelectric Power Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "A single export corridor and nationwide blackout", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「水錘與導葉關閉規律」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；古里水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Water hammer and guide-vane closure" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Guri Hydroelectric Power Plant must be respecified.

courses.summary: 伊泰普位於巴拉那河的巴西與巴拉圭交界。1973 年的條約與 1984 年開始發電，顯示大型機電工程同時需要長期制度安排與分期整合。地圖為大壩的概略代表點，不是施工入口或機組座標。
courses.summaryEn: Itaipu sits on the Paraná River between Brazil and Paraguay. The 1973 treaty and start of generation in 1984 show how a major electromechanical project combines institutional arrangements with staged integration. The map is an approximate dam reference point, not a construction entrance or unit coordinate.

history.title: 簽署伊泰普條約
history.text: 巴西與巴拉圭以條約建立共同開發水力資源的框架。
history.textEn: Brazil and Paraguay established a treaty framework for joint hydropower development.

history.title: 開始發電
history.text: 伊泰普於五月開始發電，電站由建設轉入分期機組運轉。
history.textEn: Itaipu began generating in May as construction transitioned into staged unit operation.

courses.connectionEn: Locate the cross-border water resource, then separate water balance, shaft power and national-grid interfaces.
